summary: Mandatory tenant background verification under Criminal Procedure Code to ensure neighborhood security.

steps.title: Collect tenant identity documents
steps.description: Obtain tenant's Aadhaar card, permanent native village address, employer identity card, and 2 passport photos.

steps.title: Submit on Citizen Police Portal / App
steps.description: Landlord registers property details and submits tenant personal history online.

steps.title: Local police station verification
steps.description: Beat constable conducts background check and verifies record with native district police station.

steps.title: Download Police Clearance Slip
steps.description: Download digitally stamped verification acknowledgement receipt for records.
